verification.validation: Focused release gate: Go tests of idgateway and installsettings (origin port, dsm-passthrough cookies, authorize CGI origin return, warn-policy ports, ChangePorts), docs and version checks, executor manifest check, basic gate and npm pack scans. No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: A path-ingress identity gateway can serve a second, administrator-only origin on its own HTTPS port (Config.Origin, OriginVersion 1) through a separate mutually authenticated socket, with its own session cookie; the authorize CGI accepts that origin's return.
Cookie mode dsm-passthrough forwards DSM's _SSID, _CrPoSt and stay_login and strips only the gateway's cookies and DSM's id and did.
Installer ports may declare conflict: warn; installsettings.ChangePorts changes installed ports after installation.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
